caption: The drawing depicts a single, centrally positioned metal cauldron with three short legs and a rounded body. The cauldron is dark brown, with some lighter shading to suggest highlights and texture. It features a wide opening at the top and a thick rim, and an arched handle extends upward from both sides of the rim, forming a semicircular shape above the cauldron. The background is a light beige or off-white color, with no additional objects, details, or decorations visible. The cauldron is rendered with shading to suggest volume, and there is a faint shadow beneath its legs, indicating it is standing on a flat surface. The artist’s signature appears in the lower right corner of the drawing.
title: Potato Kettle
